prompt: Create a minimalist vertical typographic poster on a warm ivory paper background. Center the composition with four oversized Chinese characters arranged as a 2 by 2 grid spelling 花样年华, drawn in an elegant ultra-thin monoline style with tall geometric proportions, rounded stroke ends, and large airy spacing. Use dark charcoal-black strokes for the characters, with a restrained modern calligraphic feel rather than a standard font. Between the top and bottom character rows, place a small centered English subtitle in widely spaced uppercase letters reading IN THE MOOD FOR LOVE, in a clean thin sans-serif font. Add two flowing ribbon-like decorative strokes made of many fine parallel contour lines in a soft red-to-golden-orange gradient: one sinuous vertical ribbon weaving from the upper left through the center toward the lower right, and one shorter horizontal wave crossing the upper-right characters. The ribbons should appear delicate, translucent, and layered behind and between the black character strokes, evoking silk, smoke, or musical lines. Keep the layout uncluttered, symmetrical but organic, with generous margins, no border, no photographs, no extra text, no logos, and no watermark. Use a refined art-house film poster aesthetic combining Chinese typography, modern graphic design, and subtle romantic warmth.
